title: Make the coverage estimand falsifiable — pin the ruler, not just the assertion set
verdict_class: run-gate instrumentation (NOT install-strength). No split arm, no held-out arm, no provider calls, no training run.
scope: kanto unit corpus, 105 clean docs, seed-0 sample of 20, replayed provider-free through --facts-json against fixture 0b50daf3.

defect.statement: The fixture froze 376 assertions and nothing else. The CLEAN denominator is also a function of the entity table (subject_in_unit + the object-type check's entity_type lookup) and the domain manifest (the contract), and the sampled document list is a function of the .md tree. All three were unpinned and unreported, so clean_ratio was selectable in [0.0000, 1.0000] with a byte-identical triples file.

defect.correction_to_the_premise_audit: The audit's structural_assumption #5 said the item's '+0.8077 -> 1.0000' was NOT reproducible from addition-only entity edits and ceilinged at 0.7143. That is wrong — its construction carried an extra constraint ('chosen so no hit's object is disturbed'). Dropping that constraint, 55 addition-only rows reach exactly 1.0000/11 with a byte-identical triples file, and a manifest-only edit reaches 1.0000/0 independently. The item's original magnitude was right. Everything else in the audit reproduced exactly (0.1923/78, 0.0532/376, 189 = 154 unresolved + 35 mismatch, 109 out_of_unit, 3/20 and 12/20 sample collapse).

fix.mechanism: The ruler pin. Four digests — fixture, entities, id_map, domain manifest — are frozen in data/_build/recall/<domain>/<unit>.ruler.json and verified on every fixture-mode run. A mismatch is FAIL with the named file, and the printed summary emits clean_ratio/raw_ratio as null. The TRIPLES FILE IS DELIBERATELY NOT PINNED: it is the thing under measurement.
fix.why_not_a_frozen_entity_snapshot: The premise audit measured that freezing the entity table for SCORING would blind the 154 object_type_unresolved assertions a genuine re-extraction rescues. Pinning-and-failing-closed has the opposite property: the live table is still used, so a genuine gain is scored at full sensitivity; only an UNDECLARED ruler change is refused.
secondary_fixes: Fixture/sample alignment: a sampled document the fixture does not cover is FAIL, not assertable=[].
A clean denominator of 0 is FAIL, not PASS. At HEAD, emptying the denominator via the manifest turned kanto's 0.1923 FAIL into a 1.0000 PASS.
--no-ruler-pin is not a bypass: an ignored pin sets quotable=false and is reported in ruler.pins_ignored.
Re-pinning is allowed and cannot be silent: the new pin carries `supersedes` (previous digests + row counts) and --pin-ruler prints the row deltas and a NEW-SERIES warning.
reject_reasons breakdown and the clean_unfiltered arm added so the estimand choice is an argued number.

honest_limits: The pin is a trust anchor, not a proof. Anyone may re-pin after editing the entity table and then quote a passing number — shadow_obj + --pin-ruler yields clean 1.0000/11 with quotable true. The defense is the same one the assertion fixture already relies on: the pin is a committed file, `supersedes` records what it replaced (entities 959 -> 1014 rows), and --pin-ruler prints a NEW-SERIES warning. Reviewable, not impossible.
Enforcement is opt-in per unit. A unit with no .ruler.json keeps every lever open; only its ruler is now RECORDED on the report. Only kanto is pinned by this item.

The 0.6 gate still rides `clean` (0.1923). This item did not move the gated estimand — moving it to clean_unfiltered (0.0749) or raw (0.0532) restates every number in the h5 trail and is a campaign, not a patch. Both arms are now co-reported so that decision can be made on arithmetic.
Nothing here closes the coverage gap itself. kanto remains FAIL at 0.1923 against 0.6, with 9 failed predicates. This is measurement plumbing only.
Miss-guided re-extraction stays DEFERRED per the item — it needs a held-out arm, since injecting gold triples into prompts for docs scored against that same gold is answer-key leakage.

supersedes_in_flight: An unreviewed, unreceipted r3 implementation was sitting uncommitted in the working tree (scripts/pipeline/audit_recall.py + test_audit_recall.py, mtime 05:45). It is SUPERSEDED by this artifact. Its two sound contributions are preserved and reimplemented: the ruler provenance block and the fixture-coverage fail-closed. Its central move — deleting the object-type contract from the CLEAN denominator — is rejected on measurement: (1) its own docstring claimed entity additions become '+0.0000', but measured against it the same 203-row entity synthetic still moved the gated ratio 0.0749 -> 0.0635 and the 13-row subject synthetic moved it 0.0749 -> 0.0532, because subject_in_unit still reads the live entity table; (2) it diluted the gated denominator 78 -> 267, cutting genuine-gain sensitivity 3.4x (+0.0128 -> +0.0038 for one added triple); (3) it silently redefined the gated baseline from 0.1923 to 0.0749, breaking comparability with the whole h5 trail. Its contract-inertness argument is preserved as the non-gated clean_unfiltered arm.
